extracted.name: Honey Mustard Dressing
extracted.description: This homemade honey mustard dressing is sweet and tangy, with a perfect lightly creamy texture. Toss it with a salad, use it as a dipping sauce, or drizzle it over roasted veggies. Find specific suggestions in the post above!
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or fresh lemon juice
¼ teaspoon sea salt (more to taste)
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, whisk together the mustard, olive oil, vinegar, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper.
See the above blog post for serving suggestions.
